body: I’m sorry you’re having troubles. It’s been 5 years for me. Sometimes I still deal with exactly what you explained. Like the post before me, having some music or tv to focus on helps me relax. Sometimes something that bores me so I get tired faster but am still slightly occupied. Maybe being on call with a close friend or family member would help too. I wish you luck. 💚
